title: Payment of Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Cancellation Refunds
content:
A computed cancellation refund on a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan is paid within the plan's refund payment period, counted in calendar days after the cancellation is processed. It is paid in one payment for the full amount due.

## Payee
| Plan financed on the installment contract? | Plan pays financed refunds to the lienholder? | Paid to |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes (every Kessler Care plan) | The lienholder named on the plan |
| No | — | The plan holder |

## Further terms
- A refund of 0.00 is not paid, and no payment entry is made.
- A refund is paid only once per refund calculation. A refund calculation that already carries a payment is not paid again.

Hypothetical illustration: a refund of 212.40 due on a plan recorded as financed on the installment contract, with a named lender, is paid in one payment of 212.40 to that lender. The same refund on a plan bought outright is paid to the holder.
